objective: Test whether the surviving scalar mask1 character is a zero/nonzero (presence) circuit of one primitive marginal resource field after the exact triangle-parity cancellation of raw count parity.
source: EW-RS-093 COV_0 marginal triangle records. Fields are T_i and |N_i| for channels C,Z0,P0,Z1,P1.
candidateFamily: For one selected field F, form three edge bits b1,b2,b3=[F>0]. Compute e1=b1 xor b2 xor b3, e2=b1b2 xor b1b3 xor b2b3, e3=b1b2b3. Test all7 nonzero XOR combinations of e1,e2,e3 for each of the10 fields, for70 candidates total.
candidateColumn: A triangle contributes f(b1,b2,b3); a dependency value is XOR across its frozen OOO triangle residue.
procedure: Prepare all70 structural columns before reading scalar codes.
Replay only scalar mask1 on all462 trained dependencies.
Report every exact candidate and realized-column equivalence classes.
If none pass, presence of any single marginal field is insufficient and the search must move to joint field association, not arbitrary fitted coefficients.
guards: No sign-correlation, geometry tag, motif ID or state exception.
No sealed-holdout access or RS096 continuation.
